user.title: Connect to your GoodWe ETA inverter
user.description: Connect GW EnergyPilot directly to the GoodWe ETA inverter over Modbus TCP. Before continuing, make sure the inverter uses a static IP address or DHCP reservation so its address cannot change.

data_description.host: Fixed IP address of the GoodWe ETA inverter. Configure a static IP address or DHCP reservation in your router.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port. The normal GoodWe ETA value is 502.
data_description.slave: Modbus Unit ID. The commonly used GoodWe ETA value is 247.

controller.title: Configure EMHASS control
controller.description: EnergyPilot can now run EMHASS optimization and publish natively. New installations enable the built-in orchestrator by default. Keep Automatic Control OFF until the first successful optimization has published a valid P_batt target.

data.emhass_soc_final_pct: Target SOC at end of optimization

data_description.p_batt_entity: Standard value: sensor.p_batt_forecast. The state must be numeric and expressed in watts.
data_description.optim_required_state: EnergyPilot only follows EMHASS when the optimization status matches this value. Standard value: Optimal.
data_description.max_power_kw: Maximum charge or discharge power EnergyPilot may request from the inverter. For a 15 kW inverter use 15.0 kW.
data_description.deadband: Targets inside this range around 0 W are treated as Battery Hold. Recommended: 300 W; typical range 200-500 W.
data_description.scan_interval: How often EnergyPilot refreshes GoodWe ETA telemetry. Recommended: 10 seconds.
data_description.enable_emhass_orchestrator: Runs optimization independently from Automatic Control. Existing installations should remove the legacy EnergyPilot EMHASS YAML before enabling this schedule.
data_description.emhass_url: Local EMHASS API base URL. The default is the standard Home Assistant EMHASS add-on hostname.
data_description.emhass_optimization_interval: How often EnergyPilot runs a fresh optimization. Recommended: 15 minutes.
data_description.emhass_soc_final_pct: SOC target passed as soc_final. This does not replace your EMHASS minimum/maximum battery SOC settings.
data_description.emhass_fallback_load: Used only when current load or Recorder history cannot provide a plausible load forecast.
data_description.use_nordpool_prices: When the official Home Assistant Nord Pool integration is available, EnergyPilot sends timestamped market prices to EMHASS. Disable this to use the price method configured inside EMHASS.
data_description.nordpool_area: Optional. Leave empty to use the first area returned by the configured Nord Pool integration. Enter e.g. NL when needed.
data_description.nordpool_currency: Currency requested from Nord Pool. Recommended: EUR.
data_description.buy_price_adder: Amount added to the Nord Pool spot import price in EUR/kWh for supplier fees, taxes or other variable costs.
data_description.sell_price_deduction: Amount subtracted from the Nord Pool spot export price in EUR/kWh. The validated Tibber setup used 0.0248 EUR/kWh.
data_description.enable_ev_coordination: Optional. When enabled, EnergyPilot can react to an EV charging state or charging power entity.
data_description.ev_power_entity: Optional EV charging-power entity in watts.
data_description.ev_deadband: Charging power above this value is considered active EV charging.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the GoodWe ETA inverter or read EMS registers 47511/47512. Verify the inverter IP address, port, Unit ID and Modbus TCP availability.

abort.already_configured: This GoodWe ETA inverter is already configured.

init.title: GW EnergyPilot options
init.description: Configure GoodWe control and the native EMHASS orchestrator. On upgrades, the built-in automatic optimizer schedule remains OFF until you explicitly enable it so it cannot conflict with an existing YAML scheduler.

data.emhass_soc_final_pct: Target SOC at end of optimization

data_description.max_power_kw: Maximum charge or discharge power EnergyPilot may request, expressed in kW.
data_description.enable_emhass_orchestrator: Remove/disable the legacy EnergyPilot EMHASS YAML before enabling this recurring schedule.
data_description.emhass_fallback_load: Fallback only; normal operation uses current EnergyPilot load plus Recorder history.
data_description.use_nordpool_prices: Disable to let EMHASS use its own configured price forecast method.
data_description.nordpool_area: Optional market area such as NL. Empty uses the first returned area.
data_description.buy_price_adder: Extra import cost added to spot price in EUR/kWh.
data_description.sell_price_deduction: Export fee/deduction subtracted from spot price in EUR/kWh.
data_description.ev_power_entity: Optional EV charging-power entity in watts.
data_description.ev_deadband: Power above this threshold is considered active EV charging.
